basic_details.job_title: NIT Warangal Programmer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Technology Warangal has released an advertisement for the post of Programmer on a purely temporary basis under Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Implementation Services by NIT Warangal to NIT Manipur. Eligible candidates must send their filled application form, resume, and supporting documents through email to [email protected] by 8th November 2026 (11:59 PM).

age_limit.details: 30 Years. The prescribed age limit may be relaxed in deserving cases, subject to approval of the competent authority. Age relaxation applies as per Government of India Norms.

qualification.details: First Class B. E. / B. Tech. in CSE / IT / EC or equivalent, or M.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent, or MCA from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 1 year of relevant experience. | 30 Years. The prescribed age limit may be relaxed in deserving cases, subject to approval of the competent authority. Age relaxation applies as per Government of India Norms. | Knowledge of Spring Boot, MVC frameworks, web development frameworks, Java/J2EE technologies, JSP, JDBC, HTML5, JSON, JavaScript/jQuery, PostgreSQL/RDBMS, and software development life-cycle processes.

selection_process: Candidates may be selected through a programming skill test and/or interview conducted jointly by NIT Manipur and NIT Warangal
in physical or online mode. Selected candidates shall work at NIT Manipur and/or NIT Warangal
for ERP implementation of NIT Manipur
subject to the directions of the competent authority and the terms of engagement.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary. Duration is initially for a period of six months, extendable up to a maximum of twenty-four months, subject to satisfactory performance and implementation requirements. List of shortlisted candidates will be announced on the NIT Warangal website and also intimated through email. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview online or offline. If the interview needs to be conducted online, candidates are expected to have a good Internet connection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Whom to contact for queries: Prof. Sanjaya Kumar Panda, Head, CDIS and Associate Professor, Department of CSE, NIT Warangal, Warangal – 506004, Telangana, India. Contact Email ID and Mobile Number: [email protected], +91-9861126947.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Warangal Programmer
content_sections.text: The Centre for Digital Infrastructure and Services (CDIS) at the National Institute of Technology Warangal, located in Warangal, Telangana, has issued this recruitment notification to execute ERP implementation services for NIT Manipur. The appointment is for a purely temporary position to support new development, re-engineering, and maintenance of the ERP system across twenty-four months.

content_sections.text: First Class B. E. / B. Tech. in CSE / IT / EC or equivalent, or M.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent, or MCA from a recognized University/Institution with minimum 1 year of relevant experience. 30 Years. The prescribed age limit may be relaxed in deserving cases, subject to approval of the competent authority. Age relaxation applies as per Government of India Norms. Knowledge of Spring Boot, MVC frameworks, web development frameworks, Java/J2EE technologies, JSP, JDBC, HTML5, JSON, JavaScript/jQuery, PostgreSQL/RDBMS, and software development life-cycle processes.

rows.pay: INR 40,000/- per month (Consolidated) and No HRA

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal Programmer Job Description
content_sections.text: Programming, unit testing, client-side coordination, development, re-engineering, and maintenance of the ERP system. First Year: New development and re-engineering of ERP. Second Year: New development, re-engineering, and maintenance. Execute the objectives of the ERP implementation services.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates may be selected through a programming skill test and/or interview conducted jointly by NIT Manipur and NIT Warangal, in physical or online mode. Selected candidates shall work at NIT Manipur and/or NIT Warangal, as required, for ERP implementation of NIT Manipur, subject to the directions of the competent authority and the terms of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary. Duration is initially for a period of six months, extendable up to a maximum of twenty-four months, subject to satisfactory performance and implementation requirements. List of shortlisted candidates will be announced on the NIT Warangal website and also intimated through email. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend an interview online or offline. If the interview needs to be conducted online, candidates are expected to have a good Internet connection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Whom to contact for queries: Prof. Sanjaya Kumar Panda, Head, CDIS and Associate Professor, Department of CSE, NIT Warangal, Warangal – 506004, Telangana, India. Contact Email ID and Mobile Number: [email protected] , +91-9861126947.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the NIT Warangal Programmer position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Programmer post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIT Warangal Programmer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send the filled application through email is 8th November 2026 by 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a First Class B.E. / B.Tech. in CSE / IT / EC or equivalent, or M.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent, or MCA from a recognized University or Institution with a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years, with relaxations applicable as per Government of India norms and subject to approval by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Programmer position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of INR 40,000/- per month with no HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email only to [email protected] with the subject line “Application for Programmer – October 2026”.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection procedure for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates may be selected through a programming skill test and/or an interview conducted jointly by NIT Manipur and NIT Warangal in physical or online mode.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The position is initially for a period of six months and is extendable up to a maximum of twenty-four months based on satisfactory performance and implementation requirements.
